newsitem.title: USA: Two U.S. Customs agents shot at Mexican border.
newsitem.headline: Two U.S. Customs agents shot at Mexican border.

text.p: Two U.S. Customs agents were shot and wounded at the U.S.-Mexico border on Thursday by a gunman who was then shot dead, a spokesman said.
The shooting occurred near the border crossing point at Calexico, some 120 miles (200 km) east of San Diego, said Senior Customs Inspector Louis Semon.
"The subject is dead," he said, referring to the gunman. Asked how the man died, the spokesman said: "I believe he was shot by one of the downed inspectors."
The extent of the inspectors' injuries was not known, he said. "They could be life-threatening."
Semon said the shooting took place in an office of the Customs Service after the gunman had already crossed into the United States from Mexico.
No further details of the incident were immediately available.
